description: Saving a personal meeting note: length and meeting status limits.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
The actor never saved a note at this place; no note exists there.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: null (the meeting as a whole); body: "Ghi chú buổi họp"; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: Success with the saved note ("Đã lưu ghi chú." MSG415); a change notice is published so the other open windows refetch.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
The actor saved a note here before and read it back; nothing landed after that read.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: the item; body: "Nội dung mới"; loadedAt: the updatedAt the actor read.
cases.return: Success with the updated note (MSG415); the 1 ms window absorbs the precision the database drops.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
The actor never saved a note at this place.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: null; body: exactly 20.000 characters; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: Success; a note of exactly the maximum length is kept whole (MSG415).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair (a reader of the meeting, not its Secretary).
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Chair; agendaItemId: null; body: "Ghi chú"; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: Forbidden; 403 "Chỉ Thư ký được ghi chú cuộc họp." (MSG416); the panel keeps the typed text to copy and nothing about the notes is disclosed.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor was the Secretary but has just been replaced.
The actor types a note while the replacement is already current.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the former Secretary; agendaItemId: null; body: "Ghi chú"; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: Forbidden (MSG416); only the current Secretary writes.

preconditions: Actor's account is deactivated.
cases.inputs: meetingId: any meeting; actorId: the deactivated account; body: "Ghi chú".
cases.return: Inactive; 403 with no message code; nothing is saved.

preconditions: Actor cannot read the meeting (stranger, or meeting does not exist).
cases.inputs: meetingId: that meeting; actorId: the stranger; body: "Ghi chú".

preconditions: Meeting Published (not started yet); actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: null; body: "Ghi chú"; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: Closed; 409 "Chỉ ghi chú khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra, hoặc sau khi kết thúc mà chưa tạo bản nháp biên bản." (MSG417).

preconditions: Meeting Ended and its minutes draft already exists; actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: null; body: "Ghi chú"; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: Closed (MSG417); the draft takes over and the notes close.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: null; body: 20.001 characters; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: TooLong; 400 "Ghi chú quá dài, tối đa 20.000 ký tự." (MSG419); nothing is saved.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
The agenda item is not (or no longer) part of the meeting.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: that item; body: "Ghi chú"; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: ItemGone; 409 "Mục nghị sự này không còn trong cuộc họp." (MSG420).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
The note was saved from another window after the actor read it.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: the item; body: "Ghi chú mới"; loadedAt: the older updatedAt.
cases.return: Stale; 409 "Ghi chú vừa được sửa ở cửa sổ khác. Tải lại để xem bản mới nhất." (MSG418); nothing is overwritten.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
A note already exists at this place but the actor never read it (nothing was loaded).
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: the item; body: "Ghi chú mới"; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: Stale (MSG418); without a read time the existing note is never overwritten.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
No note exists at this place but the actor sends a read time (the note there is gone).
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: the item; body: "Ghi chú mới"; loadedAt: some past time.
cases.return: Stale (MSG418); a note the caller claims to have seen no longer exists.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
The agenda item is deleted after the checks but before the write lands.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: that item; body: "Ghi chú"; loadedAt: null.
cases.log: Agenda item {ItemId} went away while its note was saved.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
The write fails in storage.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: null; body: "Ghi chú"; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: SaveFailed; 503 "Không lưu được ghi chú. Nội dung vẫn giữ trên máy này và sẽ gửi lại." (MSG422); the text stays on the device and is sent again.
cases.log: Could not save a note in meeting {MeetingId}.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
The note is committed, but the change notice cannot be published.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: the Secretary; agendaItemId: null; body: "Ghi chú"; loadedAt: null.
cases.return: Success with the saved note; a committed write stays successful even when the notice fails — the other window finds out on its next save.
cases.log: Could not publish the note change in meeting {MeetingId}.
